group.name: Are you using Unlimited Companion Framework (EFF.esp)?

plugin.name: Yes - I use Unlimited Companion Framework
plugin.description: Installs the version that merges UCF's changes to the vanilla Followers quest with Synthetic Love's custom affinity events (loves/likes/dislikes/hates). Without this merge, whichever of the two loads last wipes out the other's changes. Also contains the Kellogg fix. Requires EFF.esp.

plugin.name: No - I don't use UCF
plugin.description: Installs the version without UCF as a requirement. Without UCF there is no Followers conflict to fix (Nora Spouse's copy of that quest is unchanged from vanilla). Contains the Kellogg fix only.

group.name: If you leave synth Nora waiting in Vault 111 ("I need time")...

plugin.name: She waits forever
plugin.description: Synth Nora stays in Vault 111 until you come back and decide. No extra file.

plugin.name: She leaves after a while
plugin.description: If you don't come back within 7 in-game days, she leaves a note on her pod and goes off on her own, the same path as choosing "Go your own way". Installs NoraAndNora - Impatient.esp (light plugin).

group.name: Synth Nora's battle site (if she is sent away)

plugin.name: Install the battle site
plugin.description: If synth Nora leaves Vault 111, she can later be found dead at a random-encounter spot in T-51c power armor, among dead coursers and synths, carrying "Nora's Final Wish". Installs NoraAndNora - Battle Site.esp (light plugin). Requires Random Encounter Framework and all three DLCs (Automatron, Far Harbor, Nuka-World).

plugin.name: Skip it
plugin.description: No battle site. If she leaves the vault, she is simply gone.

plugin.name: Subversion - The Institute-Railroad Alliance
plugin.description: Both Noras react to Subversion's choices: sparing the Railroad, freeing the synths, the Directorate meeting, X6-88's memory wipe, replacing Maxson, Danse's reset, the Minutemen taking the Institute and more, with voiced lines. After the synths are freed (relationship tier 2 or higher) synth Nora asks "They're free... am I?". Installs NoraAndNora - Subversion.esp (light plugin). Requires InstituteReformation.esp.

plugin.name: Test tape
plugin.description: Adds "Nora and Nora: Test Tape", free to make at any chem station (Utility). Reading it opens a menu: status, advance to the next relationship tier, set tier 1-5, skip the current wait, bring both Noras to you, and reset the relationship. For testing; leave it unticked for a normal playthrough. Installs NoraAndNora - Test Tape.esp (light plugin).
